summary: Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) to disclose an adverse jury verdict in an employment-related lawsuit. A former employee of its indirect subsidiary, Fashion Valley, was awarded $35 million in compensatory damages and $70 million in punitive damages for retaliatory termination. The Company, not a party to the case, and Fashion Valley dispute the verdict, plan to challenge it via post-trial motions and appeal. The filing is a routine litigation update, not a special situation event. No deal or strategic action is present. Watch for post-trial motions outcomes and potential financial impact.
